measures.construct: The number of word tokens in the document's prose view, markup excluded. An inventory count, not a stratum measure.
measures.interpretation: Unicode-aware: a word containing non-ASCII letters counts as a word. On space-delimited scripts this tracks the whitespace-token count to within a few percent; a large gap indicates the tokenizer is dropping words.

measures.construct: Deviation from uniform information density at local scale: the variance of per-token surprisal (bits) under a fixed small causal LM (GPT-2-small), over the prose view. Uniform delivery scores low; prosody that concentrates information at stressed points scores high.

null.derived_from: the same document with word order destroyed (scramble_words): the surprisal profile of order-free text is the no-prosody expectation the observed variance is read against

measures.interpretation: A model-conditioned quantity: values are comparable only under the identical model, revision and windowing recorded in params. Computed on the prose view, so markup weight does not register as rhythm (rho with markup fraction is -0.05 on block B, n = 198). No genre claim: omega-squared across block B genres is 0.0857 (p = 0.0015, label-noise floor 0.0523), significant but below the 0.10 claim threshold. The lyric specimen ranks at quantile 0.96 of block B against a gate of 0.75 (corpus/exhibits/surprisal-variance.json).

measures.construct: How mixed the page's material is: Shannon entropy of the non-blank block-kind distribution (prose, headings, list items, tables, code fences). Pure prose reads near 0; working documentation that alternates kinds reads high.

null.derived_from: merged documents collapsed to a single prose block, where the kind distribution is degenerate and entropy is near 0 by construction

measures.interpretation: Material mix of the page. measures.construct: The typical size of the author's layout chunk: how much material sits between blank lines, counting list items, headings and prose alike. A property of how the author breaks the page, not of what the words say.

measures.interpretation: Separates the seven block B genres: omega-squared 0.125 (p = 5e-4, label-noise floor 0.055, n = 198) against the 0.10 discrimination gate. Prose-heavy genres run long chunks, list-heavy genres run short ones.

measures.construct: How wide the outline fans: mean immediate subsections per sectioning heading that has any. Flat outlines read 0.

null.derived_from: documents with every heading flattened to level 1, where no parent-child relation exists and branching is 0 by construction

measures.interpretation: Fan-out of the outline tree, read beside depth: a deep narrow tree and a shallow wide one differ at the same heading count. Carries no genre claim: omega-squared is 0.0079 at power (p = 0.28, block B). Order-invariance is not claimed: a paragraph shuffle reorders the level sequence and re-parents subtrees.

measures.construct: How deep the document's sectioning hierarchy nests: the deepest heading level in use. A property of the outline's shape, independent of what any section says.

null.derived_from: documents with every heading flattened to level 1, where depth is 1 by construction (not from the corpus being judged)

measures.interpretation: Depth of the outline. Reordering sections cannot move it (the level multiset survives a shuffle); only re-levelling can. On block B, omega-squared is 0.0883 (p = 0.001, label-noise floor 0.051), below the 0.10 discrimination gate, so no genre claim is carried.

measures.construct: The typical size of the author's prose paragraph: how much material is packed between paragraph breaks in running prose, headings and list items excluded. A shape property of the document, independent of what the words say.

null.derived_from: documents with paragraph boundaries removed, so no compositional unit exists to measure (not from the distribution of the corpus being judged)

measures.interpretation: Valid as a construct (its falsifiers move it, its invariances hold) and not a genre discriminator: prose-paragraph size is close to constant across the seven block B genres (omega-squared 0.0125, p = 0.17, n = 198). The genre signal belongs to layout chunks, which shape.chunk-length-median reads.

measures.construct: How unevenly material is distributed across sections: interquartile range over median of words-per-section. Uniform sectioning reads near 0; a page with one giant section among stubs reads high.

null.derived_from: documents with material dealt equally across their headings, where dispersion is 0 by construction (not the judged corpus's own distribution)

measures.interpretation: Evenness of the sectioning: how the author budgets material, not what the material says. measures.construct: How often the outline skips levels on the way down: a count of heading transitions that deepen by two or more. An inventory of outline discipline; most documents count 0.
measures.interpretation: Outline discipline by genre: omega-squared 0.2027 (p = 5e-4, label-noise floor 0.059) on block B; informal genres skip levels, curated ones do not. Read as a count, not a quality score.
